description: Mapping layer from clauses to MIT AI Risk Repository subdomains (the catalogue's risk hub). 'mitigates': the clause sets a duty that reduces the risk; 'relates_to': the clause concerns the risk area without mitigating it. Clauses on generic risk-management process (e.g. 'run a risk assessment') are deliberately left unmapped. Kept separate from policy records because the same clause can imply different risks for different AI systems.
